_comment: Material presets: what a Blender material is built from (lookdev_blender.hair) and what Godot must add back after glTF drops it (godot/addons/lookdev/lookdev_materials.gd). 'godot' values are StandardMaterial3D properties written into the material's glTF extras; colours given as a share of the base colour are resolved when the material is made. See references/hair.md.

hair.description: Strand hair on shells and cards: a strand texture with a root-to-tip gradient and alpha-thinned roots and tips (MASK, so it survives glTF), anisotropic highlight across the strands, backlight and a soft rim in Godot.
